notes.title: Localization Support Update
notes.content:
[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added: Localized to Portuguese.
[*] Added: Localized to Simplified Chinese (Thanks to Sound of Mystery @SoM_loc!)
[*] Added: Undo multiple steps by holding the undo key.
[*] Added: Alternative camera option to focus on the level when zoomed out.
[*] Added: Option to hide the cursor when using the keyboard.
[*] Added: Subtitles for the ending scene.
[*] Updated: User Interface layout.
[/list]

Thank you once again for your suggestions and feedback.
Cheers!

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Thank you all for your support and feedback. You are awesome! 

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed unintended solutions for levels: 82, 86, and 92. Thank you to the Steam User 18111398 for pointing it out!
[*] Fixed wireless parts from powering entities while not picked up.
[/list]

Any suggestions or feedback are always welcome.

notes.title: Snaliens, a brain-twisting family-friendly puzzle game is out now
notes.content: The Snaliens are separated and marooned on an unknown planet after some kind of mechanical problem with their spaceship, so it's up to you to reunite them in this puzzle game.
